issues.description: The problem statement and UML specify numberOfLecturers as type int, but the solution implementation declares the field and constructor parameter as byte (solution: Lecture.numberOfLecturers is a byte, constructor and setter use byte while the UML expects int). This creates a type mismatch that can confuse students about the expected attribute type and parameter types when implementing the class and its constructor/setter.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the type of numberOfLecturers consistent across artifacts. Update the solution to declare numberOfLecturers as an int (change the field, constructor parameter, and setter parameter to int) to match the UML/problem statement. Alternatively, if byte is intended, update the problem statement/UML to indicate numberOfLecturers: byte and ensure all signatures/comments reflect that change.
